title: Intent frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of an intent, expressed as JSON for validation. The body is markdown and is not schema-constrained; its required sections are a template concern.

id.description: yyyymmdd-hhhh, assigned once at creation and never changed. It is the filename, the branch suffix, the worktree name, the prefix of every acceptance-criterion id, and the retro's identity.

source.description: Where this intent came from. Settled here; the design record named every value except the ordinary case.

charter-version.description: The charter in force when this was authored.

pack-version.description: The stack pack in force, or null for a solution that consumes none.

caused-by.description: The earlier cycle whose work produced the problem this intent fixes. Accepts unknown explicitly: a guessed attribution pollutes the only unbiased signal the retro loop has, so it must never be forced.

caused-at-stage.description: Which stage of the causing cycle leaked. Only meaningful alongside caused-by.

blocked-by.description: A charter intent this one waits on. Blockedness is derived from whether that intent has merged, so nothing writes a status field.

superseded-by.description: A later intent that replaces this one. Semantic, not derivable, so it is written.

reason.description: Why this intent was abandoned. Required in practice for anything under intents/abandoned/, which is a path convention the schema cannot see.

allOf.$comment: caused-at-stage without caused-by names a stage of nothing.
A charter-review intent is the only kind that may carry the charter edit, and it is always human-approved. Recorded here so the value cannot be used casually.
